description: Gives the AI every tool registered in the Unreal Engine 5.8 Toolset Registry (the same layer Epic's built-in Unreal MCP server exposes): scene/actor/material/object tools, editor app, UMG, PCG, Niagara, GAS, physics, Slate inspector, automation tests, semantic search, plugins, config settings, agent skills and more. Runs in-process, no HTTP server needed. Also exposes the File Sandbox so risky edits can be persisted or discarded as a batch.
catalog_blurb: All UE 5.8 native toolsets + File Sandbox, in-process.
